# `current_date`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
current_date()
```

Returns the current date at the start of query evaluation. All calls of current_date within the same query return the same value.

current_date - Returns the current date at the start of query evaluation.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 0 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- current_date, example 1
> SELECT current_date();
2026-11-07
```
